test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eight children, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, and W are seated around a square dining table, all facing towards the centre. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides of the table. V is seated at a corner and R is seated at the middle of one of the sides. S is an immediate neighbour of R. Q is seated third to the right of V. There are exactly two children sitting between Q and S. T is an immediate neighbour of both V and P. W is seated second to the left of S. If U is not an immediate neighbour of V, where is R seated?

options.text: Fourth to the left of U
Third to the right of U
To the immediate left of W
Third to the right of W

solution:
Explanation:

From the given information:

Step 1: V is seated at a corner and R is seated at the middle of one of the sides. S is an immediate neighbour of R. Q is seated third to the right of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/099c0a14fd8923b08ff238c9697da24c031fa8f517a14ae2b456fe4ed19843cc.png] We place V at one corner then place Q to third right of V. We know R will be at middle so we place S at a corner.
